visualReview.notes: Inspected all 11 current portable/source-terrain frames. Individual gray-brick long hall and mapped irregular eastern rear, three domed/crossed west towers with higher square central paired-louver stage and polygonal side crowns, small lanterns and drum oculi. Two facade orders, three deep timber portals, a central rose with cross-shaped tracery, paired round-headed side lights, pale pilasters/cornices and plaque/medallion abstractions establish identity. Tall recessed side glazing sits between stepped buttress-pilasters. Corrected collapsed Float32 clipping slivers, a repeated cornice band, dome ribs hidden inside the cap, and terrain burying the north entrance. All three portals and broad treads are visible in the corrected source-terrain view. Fine sculpture, glass artwork, inscriptions and hidden partitions remain simplified or excluded.

Actual ground opening activates while visible, restores on hiding, reopens on visibility and restores on unload.

fidelityReview.notes: Medium-fi exterior based on three actually inspected pictures: BrokenSphere 2007 upper-front and close-side views, and Another Believer 2016 whole western facade. Standard viewer PMTiles/DEM only; no bespoke surveys, research datasets or redistributed reference photographs. Photographs guide three domed towers, louvered bays, rose/paired lights, two facade orders, deep portals and side buttresses. The side picture does not establish the hidden roof/rear or numeric heights; these remain explicit estimates. Belfry/lantern panels represent opaque louvers or glazing, not open-air claims. Fine carved figures/scrollwork, inscription glyphs, stained-glass art, small dentils/drains, complete interiors/bells and engineering details are approximate or excluded. Current finish, exact host-ground joins and physical-device performance are unverified.
